mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered how well you really know the people around you? Sometimes, the line between trust and terror is thinner than we think—almost invisible. That’s the unsettling space we step into together in The Stranger Beside Me: Ted Bundy: The Shocking Inside Story, written by Ann Rule. Imagine discovering the person you considered a friend, maybe even a confidant, was hiding something unthinkable. This story isn’t just about a notorious criminal; it’s about the chilling reality that evil can wear a familiar smile, and sometimes, it sits right next to us. Through Ann Rule’s eyes—someone who knew Ted Bundy personally—we’re invited into a deeply personal journey, where every twist challenges what we believe about trust, perception, and the very nature of evil. Together, we’ll peel back the layers of Bundy’s life, experiencing moments of disbelief, heartbreak, and revelation. We’ll see how even the most outwardly ordinary people can hide the darkest secrets, and how those secrets ripple out, touching everyone who thought they were safe. So, as we start this exploration, get ready for a gripping, emotional, and thought-provoking journey into true crime—a story that just might make you look twice at the world around you.
